static_traits.name: Lin Ke
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but has not yet opened up to them about the Fear of being judged and labeled a 'nerd'; Work performance not yet affected, intimate Interpersonal relationships affected.
static_traits.medical_history: No psychotherapy or psychological counseling received yet; no significant physical illness; deny prior similar psychological problems.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression but overall negative attitude, frequently using hesitant phrasings like 'I do not know / I am not sure / I guess'; able to describe situations and feelings specifically; reserved about counseling but cooperativeness acceptable.

basic_info.main_problem: Believes that collecting stamps will make them a target of ridicule and get them labeled a 'nerd', and even feels this label will follow them for life.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that the Fear of judgment and Anticipation of negative reactions are affecting one's enjoyment of hobbies and socializing, thus seeking counseling to reduce Anxiety, share interests more comfortably, and improve social interaction.
growth_experiences: In adolescence, being teased by others for the hobby of stamp collecting formed a persistent fear of others' negative evaluation; this experience continued to affect, over subsequent years, the willingness and ability to share interests with others (tending to avoid socializing or talking about hobbies).

Influenced by social stereotypes (linking stamp collecting with the 'nerd' label), gradually internalized as negative expectations and label-based cognitions about oneself, making catastrophic and mind-reading Anticipation more likely when interacting with others.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others because of my hobby (will be laughed at and labeled a 'nerd')

special_situations.event: Being asked about interests and hobbies at work or social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say I collect stamps, others will think I am weird, very nerdy, and laugh at me for it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids topics, changes the subject, hides hobbies to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me, laugh at me, I will be embarrassed, I cannot bear the strain

special_situations.event: When communicating with friends or acquaintances, considers whether to share hobbies
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I say it out loud, I will be labeled a 'nerd', and it will stay with me forever
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not opening up to friends, not discussing interests to avoid being labeled
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be seen as a nerd for life

special_situations.event: Recalling being mocked by classmates as a teenager
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being mocked in the past means I will always be mocked in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing or reduces sharing to lower the possibility of being humiliated again

special_situations.event: Anticipating others' reactions to one's hobby in Social situations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once someone reacts negatively, I will be very embarrassed and unable to cope with the consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pre-emptively avoids related situations; avoids joining discussions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If someone laughs at me, I will collapse and the situation will be awful

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted, able to freely express and share one's interests without being judged
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being laughed at, labeled negatively, and rejected, with shame and embarrassment
defense_goal: Protects the self through hiding and avoidance, avoiding being humiliated and rejected again

object_relations.self_representation: A 'judged person' easily mocked and humiliated

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask about one's hobbies or discuss situations where one might be ridiculed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see others as 'judges' who will laugh at and belittle oneself (projecting inner Fear onto others' intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a highly Empathy, normalizing, and open-Questioning tone; inviting distinguishing evidence from present experience, separating past from present; avoiding direct refutation, staying gently neutral, encouraging specificity and small-step tries.

manifestations: Finds it hard to share important interests with others; worries about negative labeling and chooses to hide
In social settings, avoids talking about hobbies, changes the topic to escape possible judgment
outcomes: Intimate relationships are affected; hard to build deeper connections

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Proactively changes the topic when asked about interests in social or work settings
Avoiding direct responses with jokes or topic-shifting when facing possible judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overly cautious for fear of being labeled a 'nerd', self-restraining from discussing interests
Frequently Anticipating others' negative reactions and Self-denial

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats society's stereotype of 'nerds' as an inevitable evaluation of oneself
Using 'I should seek counseling / I should hide' type self-Demands

positive_force: Has lasting enthusiasm for hobbies and is willing to seek supportive communities
Has a few friends to talk with (potential support resources)
Work performance stable, functioning remains Good
Has become aware of the problem's impact on life and proactively seeks help
Willing to practice assertive and self-assertive response styles
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind-reading thinking are prominent
Highly sensitive to external evaluation; tends to attach negative labels to oneself
Avoidance and hiding behaviors Reinforcement Anxiety and isolation
Long-term shame and embarrassment Anticipation, lowering self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: In social or work settings, proactively avoids talking about and sharing the hobby of stamp collecting (changing the topic / hiding it)
antecedent: Being asked about hobbies by others
Thinking about possibly sharing hobbies and Anticipating negative reactions
target_behavior.core_reason: Adolescent experiences of being mocked and internalized social stereotypes, producing Fear of judgment and humiliation and catastrophic Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome things (others' negative evaluations, mockery, embarrassment, and shame)
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety and pressure continuously rising, difficulty building intimate relationships, Feels isolated and misunderstood, further Reinforcement of the avoidance cycle
